T: Gotham turns 200. The Joker brings the balloons.
D: Batman faces the Joker as Gotham City celebrates its 200th birthday.
P: Serve dessert when the Joker throws his parade with the balloons.
S: the Joker's art gallery party, before the paint goes everywhere
Smoked salmon on rye, and beetroot-cured salmon on cucumber rounds with purple shiso or basil, a splash of green herb oil on the plate.
Popcorn tossed half in purple-tinted white chocolate and half in green, mixed together in a big bowl.
Bat-shaped chips and black bean dip
for the Batwing flying past the moon

M: Alfred serves roast beef at the very long table

the old-world delis of Gotham's back streets
Corned beef, sauerkraut and Swiss cheese on rye with Russian dressing, toasted in butter until it melts.
W: purple and green frosting, a little unhinged
Chocolate cake covered in purple buttercream with green piped swirls and a big crooked smile drawn across the top.
K: Earl Grey steeped 4 minutes in a warmed pot, milk and lemon on the side, poured into fine china.

s.how: Pop 100g kernels and split between two trays. Melt 200g white chocolate, divide in two and tint one half purple and the other green. Drizzle one over each tray and toss. Once set, break up and mix together in a big bowl.

s.n: Bat-shaped chips and black bean dip
s.note: for the Batwing flying past the moon
s.how: Cut 10 corn tortillas with a bat cutter and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Blitz 2 drained tins black beans with 2 garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes and 1 chipotle in adobo until smooth. Serve the dip with the bats.

m.note: Alfred serves roast beef at the very long table
m.how: Salt a 2kg rib of beef overnight. Roast at 120C until 52C inside, rest, then blast at 260C for 10 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 250ml red wine with 400ml stock for jus.

w.note: purple and green frosting, a little unhinged
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, tint most purple and a little green. Cover and pipe a crooked smile.

d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 Earl Grey tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and steep 4 minutes. Pour into fine china cups with milk and lemon slices on the side.
